title: Cardinality after lifting a set and adjoining the top coordinate
statement:
Let $n$ be a natural number and let $S \subseteq \{0, 1, \dots, n-1\}$. Embed $S$ into $\{0, 1, \dots, n\}$ by the map that sends each index to itself, and adjoin the top index $n$. Since $n$ is not the image of any element of $S$, this union satisfies
\[
\abs{\{\, i : i \in S \,\} \cup \{n\}} = \abs{S} + 1.
\]
hypotheses_covered: S is a finite subset of {0,...,n-1} (Finset (Fin n))
replaced:
Adjoining the (necessarily new) last coordinate to a lifted set increases its
cardinality by one:
$|\mathrm{castSucc}(S)\cup\{\mathrm{last}\,n\}| = |S| + 1$.
